task_name: Verify pipeline publication is consumed atomically across BI units

concerns_addressed: Atomic pipeline publication verified through public Artisan and admin HTTP boundaries.
Failed stage preserves prior snapshot; no partial output leaks to consumers.
Scheduler vs manual publication uses lock-based exclusion with consumer version agreement.
No production files mutated; single test-only integration file.

strengths: All required scenarios covered; established on-pipeline behaviors reused.
Refactor heuristics respected (no assertion splitting, no production mutation).

issues.description: Concurrency test pre-creates an active run and simulates overlap rather than using real concurrent workers.
Uses direct DB::table manipulation for snapshot status in setup outside model conventions.
